outcome: Admission rate to neonatal intensive care unit
finding: SGA babies were associated with a higher rate of cesarean sections for nonreassuring fetal status and a higher rate of admissions to the neonatal intensive care unit compared to appropriate-for-gestational-age babies.
mod_finding: Women with small for gestational age babies at term were more likely to have a cesarean section for nonreassuring fetal status than women with appropriate for gestational age babies.
birth_weight: SGA: <10th centile, AGA: 10th-90th centile, LGA: >90th centile
